repositories.description: An agentic geologist powered by AI

paragraphs: Ever stared at endless spreadsheets of drilling data wondering where to start and how to make sense of it all? As geologists, we spend countless hours trying to understand our deposits, constantly returning to our data with new questions and hypotheses. The challenge? Most software packages require significant data formatting before you can even begin your analysis.

Agentic Geo transforms this workflow entirely. This powerful web application acts as your "agentic geologist," capable of ingesting, processing, analysing, and interpreting standard geological datasets in moments. Built to bridge the gap between raw data and geological understanding, it automates the tedious parts so you can focus on interpretation.

Some real world data is provided to exemplify the workflow. When comparing the unsupervised machine learning domains to the logged geological units the Agent Geo outperforms the logging geologist. When viewed in 3D alongside the lithological logging, the cluster geochemical domains show better hole-to-hole correlation than the original geologists logging, particularly in the southeastern portion of the project. Here, two holes show significant logging inconsistencies compared to the broader dataset. Consistent and accurate logging is a common challenge when multiple geologists are involved in…

Automated Geological Interpretation: Powered by DeepSeakV3 for geological insights
